name: Glowing Hornshroom
description: A fungus that emits a faint light in the darkness. It is so named because its shape resembles the horny crest of an Iktomisaurus.
fullDescription: A fungus that glows with a faint light in the darkness. It resembles the horn-shaped crest of an Iktomisaurus.\nAccording to the storytellers, the first person to combine Phlogiston Engraving with oil-painted graffiti was a priest from the Masters of the Night-Wind. Despite being a nameless deviant, it was this priest who, having sensed the power that these mushrooms held, decided to collect their fluorescein and mix it with paint. This led to the birth of Nightspirit Graffiti, an art that later spread all across Tezcatepetonco Range.
sources: Recommendation: Found near the "Masters of the Night-Wind"
